item.title: About
item.description: Hi, I’m Maria I am a London-based Coach, Trainer, and Mindfulness Teacher dedicated to helping individuals and teams navigate growth with clarity and presence. My work bridges the gap between professional excellence and personal wellbeing. Currently, I focus on three core pillars: Professional Coaching Education As a Senior Faculty member at Coaching Outside the Box, I train and mentor coaches toward their ICF credentials. Wellness & Recovery I serve as a Recovery Coach, Trainer, and Mindfulness Teacher at Reframe.
